text:
The Nifty 50 closed at 25,030.35, up 2.01% on the day and 8.58% over the past five sessions, while the broader Nifty 500 rose 1.0% (7.13% weekly). Advances outpaced declines (404 vs 87) giving a breadth score of 60.3, labelled “HEALTHY”. About 65% of stocks sit above their 20‑day moving average, showing strong short‑term momentum.

Foreign Institutional Investors (FIIs) were net buyers, adding ₹14,974.68 crore today and a cumulative ₹35,808.74 crore over five days, whereas Domestic Institutional Investors (DIIs) sold ₹10,444.54 crore. The options market shows a put‑call ratio (PCR) of 1.34 for Nifty, indicating more put interest, with a “max pain” level near 24,350 and a call wall at 25,000. Bank Nifty PCR is 1.16, max pain around 56,800 and a tight call/put wall at 58,000, suggesting limited upside beyond those levels. Leading sectors include Infrastructure, Oil & Gas, Pharma and FMCG; banks and PSU banks are lagging.

Watch the 23‑Nov‑2026 Bank Nifty expiry and the Nifty support at 23,784 (S1) and pivot at 23,872. If the index holds above the 24,858 pivot, the next resistance is near 24,900‑25,000. Key headlines to monitor are Hindalco’s profit surge, pharma earnings and global AI‑related sell‑offs, which could influence sentiment in the coming session.
